title: Use Vitest for unit testing
yStatement: In the context of replacing API key auth in a serverless stack, facing the need for managed user identity, I decided to use AWS Cognito to achieve native API integration, accepting hosted UI limitations and vendor lock-in.
context: The backend uses AWS serverless services.
The extension needs login, token refresh and user identity.
decision: Use Vitest for its native Vite integration and fast feedback.
consequences: The application remains on one cloud provider.
Moving away later requires replacing the authorizer and token format.
